title: S3 endpoint rule from the booted env
detail: The https-only rule for remote S3 endpoints in production is no longer a field refinement that read the global process.env. isAcceptableS3Endpoint(value, isProduction) is applied against the env being booted: the endpoint variables carry it as an env rule (parseEnv and the boot dry run check it with the booted env record), runProdApp's fileStorage resolution applies it, and parseS3EnvConfig and createS3ProviderFromEnv take an optional env record (default process.env) and refuse a remote http endpoint when it says NODE_ENV=production. s3EndpointSchema now only validates the URL shape. createS3ProviderFromEnv reports a missing variable through requiredEnvFor (message "[S3 file provider] required env var X is missing or empty" instead of "missing_env: ...").
migration: Tests that matched the old "missing_env:" message match the requiredEnvFor message; code that parsed s3EndpointSchema alone to enforce the production https rule uses isAcceptableS3Endpoint(value, isProduction) or the env rule through parseEnv.

title: s3EndpointSchema carries the production https rule wherever it is reused
detail: The env rule lived only on the endpoint field inside `createS3EnvSchema`, so an app that built `s3EndpointSchema` into its own env schema silently lost the production check. The rule is now attached to `s3EndpointSchema` itself, env rules are found through `.optional()`, `.default()` and unions, and `s3EndpointEnvRule` is exported. With NODE_ENV=production a non-loopback `http://` endpoint is rejected by `parseEnv` and the composed boot env without app code; https and loopback http pass.
migration: Own copies of the rule (an `envRule` built on `isAcceptableS3Endpoint` next to `s3EndpointSchema`) can be removed.

title: Named S3 provider feature
detail: createFileProviderS3NamedEnvFeature mounts an additional S3 provider under its own name with an env prefix, next to the default one, so a second bucket needs no hand-written wiring.

title: S3 endpoint over http outside production
detail: s3EndpointSchema rejects http on non-loopback hosts only when NODE_ENV=production, so compose hostnames such as minio work in smoke setups.

title: s3EnvSchema and createS3EnvSchema declare the S3 provider variables
detail: s3EnvSchema covers S3_BUCKET, S3_REGION, S3_ACCESS_KEY, S3_SECRET_KEY, S3_ENDPOINT and S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE; createFileProviderS3Feature({ fromEnv: true }) registers it. createS3EnvSchema({ prefix }) builds the same block under another prefix, for example RELEASES_S3_. The endpoint must use https unless the host is loopback, and a blank endpoint counts as unset.

title: The file-provider-s3-env and files-provider-s3 subpaths are removed
detail: Both deprecated re-export subpaths of the S3 merge are gone. The env-driven provider is createFileProviderS3Feature({ fromEnv: true }) from @cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/file-provider-s3 and replaces fileProviderS3EnvFeature. S3ProviderConfig, createS3Provider, createS3ProviderFromEnv, parseS3EnvConfig and resolveForcePathStyle come from @cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/file-provider-s3/lib.
migration: Run bun kumiko-upgrade --apply. It rewrites fileProviderS3EnvFeature to createFileProviderS3Feature({ fromEnv: true }) and moves files-provider-s3 imports to file-provider-s3/lib.

title: The deprecated fileProviderS3Feature constant is removed
detail: fileProviderS3Feature was kept next to createFileProviderS3Feature() for one release. Mount the feature by calling createFileProviderS3Feature().
migration: Run bun kumiko-upgrade --apply. It replaces fileProviderS3Feature with createFileProviderS3Feature().

title: The S3 file providers merge into createFileProviderS3Feature({ fromEnv })
detail:
createFileProviderS3Feature() mounts the per-tenant config provider as before. createFileProviderS3Feature({ fromEnv: true }) mounts the env-configured provider (feature name, provider key "s3-env" and requires unchanged). The S3 client helpers (createS3Provider, createS3ProviderFromEnv, parseS3EnvConfig, resolveForcePathStyle, S3ProviderConfig) move to the new subpath @cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/file-provider-s3/lib.

The subpaths file-provider-s3-env and files-provider-s3 keep working as deprecated re-exports and are removed in the first release after 2026-10-29.

old -> new:
  fileProviderS3EnvFeature from .../file-provider-s3-env -> createFileProviderS3Feature({ fromEnv: true }) from .../file-provider-s3
  fileProviderS3Feature -> createFileProviderS3Feature()
  @cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/files-provider-s3 -> @cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/file-provider-s3/lib
migration: Run `bun kumiko-upgrade --apply`. It rewrites the imports and the env feature mount, and reports `typeof fileProviderS3EnvFeature` and re-exports of it with file and line.
